notes:
Summary: Halogen is a European SaaS provider for customer support platforms; currently piloting RAG to reduce agent load and increase automated ticket deflection. Primary focus: embeddings + reranking to ensure top-5 results are high precision while meeting tight latency SLOs.

Key metrics & targets (customer provided):
- Index scale: target production index 50M-200M tickets/docs (historical ticket corpus + KB + community forums). POC scope: 1M tickets.
- Latency SLO: p95 end-to-end for deflection path <= 180ms (goal p95 <= 150ms). Budget: retrieval ~60ms, cross-encoder rerank ~80ms, glue/decoding ~40ms.
- Rerank quality: top-5 precision target >= 90% (they said "need human-grade top-5, not approximate top-20").
- Cost goals: target infra cost per query <$0.002 at scale; POC fine with higher but wants extrapolated cost model.

Tech preferences & constraints:
- Prefer open embeddings (cost sensitivity) but will consider Redwood-verified models if latency/cost tradeoffs are favorable. Interested in quantized embeddings + Faiss/HNSW hybrid for dense recall.
- Reranker approach: light ANN retrieval (recall 100-500) + GPU cross-encoder for top-5 rerank. Ask: can Redwood host cross-encoder reranks with per-request fast warm caches?
- Deployment: must support EU data residency, VPC/private control plane. Legal prefers on-prem for regulated customers; dedicated pools for multi-tenant customers.

- 2025-11-05: Lead created from webinar ("RAG at scale for CX"). Marcus (AE) assigned.
- 2025-12-10: Intro call; CTO (Ines Duarte) outlines scale and residency constraints. Action: send security FAQ. (drive link attached)
- 2026-01-15: Deep-dive with infra + ML (Elena Park SE); discussed hybrid retrieval + rerank architecture; sketched POC plan. (ff_20260115_7890)
- 2026-01-27: Legal raised data residency + retention questions; wants KMS and audit log details.

- Ingest 1M tickets + KB snapshots, index via Redwood embeddings pipeline, run retrieval->rerank serving.
- Measure: p95 latency <= 180ms, top-5 precision >= 90%, and projected cost per query <= $0.002 at 50M scale (model + infra extrapolation).
- Deliverables: perf dashboard, token-level cost breakdown, replayable eval set for ongoing quality monitoring.
